item.title: Reconstruct the history of an unsigned poster
item.summary: A curator explains why a poster cannot yet be assigned to a famous printer.
item.transcript_text:
Interviewer: This poster is usually attributed to Oren Vale. Why change the label now?
Curator: The lettering matches Vale's shop, but the apprentices used the same wooden letters. A dated poster from an apprentice puts them in the shop at the right time.
Interviewer: Could you say the attribution is disputed?
Curator: That sounds like a public argument. The surviving evidence supports a workshop attribution. It doesn't identify an individual. The catalogue can explain what the earlier claim rested on and which part no longer holds.
Interviewer: Is anything lost when visitors see the new label?
Curator: I hope they ask different questions. Instead of looking for flashes of one person's style, they can see how people learnt and shared a trade.

options: The workshop link is better supported than individual authorship
The poster is now dated before the shop opened
Visitors asked to remove all printers’ names
A dated receipt identifies the designer
questions.explanation: Shared lettering can identify a workshop without identifying a designer.

questions.prompt: What does the apprentice’s dated poster help establish?
options: Vale’s signature was copied
Both posters necessarily had the same designer
The wood was purchased elsewhere
The apprentice could have worked there at the relevant time
questions.explanation: The date keeps another workshop member within the range of possibilities.

options: It gives the apprentices too much credit
It disagrees with a definitive archive entry
It suggests public disagreement rather than limited evidence
It refers to style rather than poster size
questions.explanation: The curator wants to describe what the evidence supports.

questions.prompt: What belongs in the longer catalogue entry?
options: Only the latest artist’s name
The grounds and limits of the earlier attribution
The curator’s personal taste
A list of all poster buyers
questions.explanation: The longer format can document how the claim developed.

questions.prompt: What might visitors notice with the new label?
options: How workshop members shared and learned a practice
What Vale did entirely alone
A definite new signature
An argument between two artists
questions.explanation: The label can redirect attention to shared practice.
